note: Authored reading trails for the Lens. A trail is an ordered path over the built typed-edge graph: each step after the first names, in `via`, the edge type walked into it, and the Lens build validates every hop against the edge table — a trail whose hop no longer exists is dropped from the artefact with its reason, never rendered as curated. Authored trails only: nothing here is generated, and a new trail enters by editing this register on the record. The demo wiki ships with no authored trails; this file shows the register's shape.
